description: This file contains the EmailConfigurationDao class, which is a Data Access Object responsible for handling database operations related to email configurations within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to retrieve and save email configuration data.

classes.name: EmailConfigurationDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for managing email configuration entities in the database.

methods.name: getEmailConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves the current email configuration from the database, returning an EmailConfiguration object or null if none exists.

methods.name: saveEmailConfiguration
methods.description: Persists the given EmailConfiguration object to the database and returns it.
